name: So I Got That Goin' For Me, Which Is Nice
aka: So I've Got That Going For Me
look: A still from Caddyshack: Bill Murray as greenskeeper Carl Spackler, in a camouflage bucket hat and gray T-shirt, squints with a lopsided, satisfied pout, standing outdoors beside a doorway with a large tree behind him.
use: The top lists something bad, embarrassing or barely positive about your life, and the bottom shrugs it off with 'so I got that goin' for me, which is nice', a deadpan way of finding a tiny silver lining.
slots: top caption: the bad situation with a tiny upside
bottom caption: 'so I got that goin' for me, which is nice'
examples: Locked out in the rain, but I found a dollar
so I got that goin' for me, which is nice
Failed the quiz but spelled my name right
so I got that goin' for me, which is nice
describe: bill murray in a camo bucket hat squinting
groundskeeper guy in a camouflage hat making a smug face
golf course worker squinting with pouty lips
man in an army bucket hat and gray shirt looking pleased with himself
scruffy guy in a camo hat smirking at the camera
origin: Bill Murray as greenskeeper Carl Spackler in the 1980 comedy Caddyshack; the line comes from his story about caddying for the Dalai Lama.
